limits: All observations, losses, probabilities and attribute cells are authored. These exercises establish no closed-loop stability, speedup, frame-pacing improvement, image quality or policy recommendation.
Three-level source adaptive controller with .05 EMA and strict >1 second guard differs from the advisory two-state, two-observation, >=3 second model.
Unavailable query skips inspected assignments while time advances; successful query is not proof of finite/nonnegative numeric input.
Historical M3 remains inconclusive and historical binary/source dirtiness is not attested away.
External documentation semantic reading is outside this fixed-data audit. The producer records direct403 for MathWorks and RAND; this audit does not upgrade those into a byte-level200 claim.
Human, fluent-language, learner, accessibility, preferences and live-renderer outcomes remain unverified.
